svg.text: Example: employee upload fails; investigation may require a product mapping fix.
Swimlanes show who acts. SupportOps records the work; technical remediation happens outside the app.
OPTIONAL FOLLOW-UP — does not block incident closure
Support / CSM: draft → review → approve → publish
Technical teams: linked Problem → preventive improvement
A restored service can close with a verified workaround; permanent prevention may continue separately.
Solid arrows: activity flow Diamonds: decisions / merge Black circle: start Ringed circle: end
CSM communications continue throughout. Specialist handoffs and sample diagnostics are used only when needed.
